name: ventdepot/ecommerce-platform
description: VentDepot marketplace. Runs with no third-party PHP packages: email, .env, object storage and payments use built-in, dependency-free code.

suggest.predis/predis: ^3.3 — only if a Redis server is added; config/redis-cache.php and config/queue-system.php fall back to file cache / immediate jobs without it (3.0–3.2 have a critical CVE)
suggest.cboden/ratchet: ^0.4 — only to run websockets/inventory-websocket-server.php (not used by the site)
suggest.phpmailer/phpmailer: ^6.9 — optional; services/EmailService.php uses the built-in SmtpMailer without it
